note: Extra Field Plus adds editable display settings to Extra Field pseudo-fields. Plugins extend ExtraFieldPlusDisplayBase (raw) or ExtraFieldPlusDisplayFormattedBase (field-template wrapped), live in your_module/src/Plugin/ExtraField/Display, use @ExtraFieldDisplay. Required static methods: extraFieldSettingsForm() and defaultExtraFieldSettings() (3.x renamed from settingsForm/defaultFormValues); optional settingsSummary(). Settings are saved into the entity_view_display component (content.extra_field_<id>.settings). Manager service plugin.manager.extra_field_plus_display; report at /admin/reports/extra_fields. Medium/hard cases use the example submodule (extra_field_plus_example) plugins example_node_label / example_node_label_formatted (settings link_to_entity + wrapper), grounded in the real entity_view_display component settings on node.article.default. Setup/reset scripts enable extra_field_plus_example.

evals.prompt: How do I create an extra field (pseudo-field) that has its own display settings using extra_field_plus? Which base classes do I extend and where does the plugin live?
evals.expected_output: Extend ExtraFieldPlusDisplayBase (raw output) or ExtraFieldPlusDisplayFormattedBase (wrapped in the field template), place the plugin in your_module/src/Plugin/ExtraField/Display/ with the @ExtraFieldDisplay annotation.

evals.prompt: In extra_field_plus 3.x, which methods must a display plugin implement to provide its settings form and their defaults?
evals.expected_output: Implement the static methods extraFieldSettingsForm() (the FAPI settings elements) and defaultExtraFieldSettings() (their defaults); optionally settingsSummary(). In 3.x these replaced the old settingsForm()/defaultFormValues().

evals.prompt: Where are an extra_field_plus extra field's chosen display settings stored, and where can I list all extra field plugins on the site?
evals.expected_output: Settings are stored in the entity_view_display component for that field (content.extra_field_<id>.settings). All extra field plugins are listed at Reports > Extra Field Plugins List (/admin/reports/extra_fields).

evals.prompt: On this site, the Example Node Label extra field (from the extra_field_plus example module) is placed on the Article default display. Inspect the live display configuration and report the 'wrapper' HTML tag setting configured for it.
evals.expected_output: The wrapper is 'h2' (component extra_field_example_node_label in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default, settings.wrapper).

evals.prompt: On this site the Example Node Label Formatted extra field is placed on the Article default display. Inspect the live configuration and state whether its 'Link to the entity' (link_to_entity) setting is enabled.
evals.expected_output: Yes — link_to_entity is true for the component extra_field_example_node_label_formatted in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On this site (with the extra_field_plus example module enabled), place the 'Example Node Label' extra field on the Article default view display and set its wrapper setting to h3. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the component extra_field_example_node_label (type extra_field_example_node_label) with settings.wrapper = 'h3' in a visible region and save.

evals.prompt: The Example Node Label Formatted extra field is placed on the Article default display but its 'Link to the entity' option is off. Turn link_to_entity ON for it and apply the change to the live display configuration.
evals.expected_output: On core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the extra_field_example_node_label_formatted component's settings.link_to_entity = true and save.
